name: Acting
description: Base chance to pose as an invented persona or three.

name: Animal Bond
description: Develop your bond with one specific animal and teach them to do remarkable things. In other words develop a familiar. Points effectively lost if the animal dies.

name: Animal Handling
description: Skill with domesticated animals and knowledge of their needs.

name: Animal Training
description: Base roll to train an animal to do a specific thing. Modified by the GM.

name: Appraising Art&Artifacts
description: Base chance to accurately assess the value of Art, Antiques and other artifacts.

name: Appraising Gems&Jewelry
description: Base chance to accurately assess the value of Gems and Jewelry.

name: Appraising Livestock
description: Base chance to accurately assess the value of Horses and other livestock.

name: Bartering
description: Skill at haggling prices, making trades.

name: Beekeeping
description: The real liquid gold.

name: Blacksmith
description: Base chance to make an iron item at a forge.

name: Bower
description: Quality of the bow you can make.

name: Boxing
description: Skill at formal fisticuffs following strict rules. In informal combat it reduces the -5 untrained penalty from unarmed combat by 1 per 10 points. In addition on a successful skill check deal your full damage bonus instead of half.

name: Brewing
description: Base chance to make beer.

name: Calligraphy
description: Skill at writing beautifully.

name: Carcass Dressing
description: Skinning, dressing and otherwise harvesting the useful parts of a carcass.

name: Carpentry
description: Base chance to build a wooden item.

name: Charming
description: Win friends and influence people.

name: Climb Walls
description: Base chance to scale a stone wall.

name: Cooking
description: Base chance to surprise and delight, depending on ingredients available.

name: Dancing
description: Such a simple name for body control, timing and grace.

name: Disarm Traps
description: Base chance to disarm a trap.

name: Disguise
description: Base chance to disguise yourself or others.

name: Drawing
description: Skill with drawing.

name: Drinking
description: Reports very widely. Your mother told you it would be the death of you. Your uncle told you it would save your life, or did he say something about savoring life? Whatever.

name: Embroidery
description: A very Ladylike pastime.

name: Engineering
description: This very powerful skill allows you to invent and construct or have constructed many things. Involves negotiation with the GM.

name: Etiquette
prereq:
Read at least 1 language
 or exposure
description: Base roll to know the proper behavior, honorific, colours etc. for a given situation.

name: Farming
description: Plant, grow, and harvest a crop.

name: Find Traps
description: base chance to find a trap.

name: First Aid
description: Base chance to bandage difficult wounds effectively, stopping further damage.

name: Fishing
description: Base chance to catch a fish with gear

name: Fletching
description: Base chance to make perfect (no penalty) shortbow arrows. perfect longbow arrows require  130 points below your skill. Perfect Greatbow arrows require 160

name: Forgery
description: Base chance for documents you forge to pass inspection.

name: Gambling
description: Base chance to win.

name: Gardening
description: It's nice to have a hobby.

name: Herb Lore
description: Base chance to: Forage effectively for edible plants and spices (+30).  Make an ointment which reduces the chance of infection by 50% (+10). Neutralize a poison. (-15) Make penicillin (cures 75% of diseases.) (-30). With skill and access to materials you can make most things that could be found over the counter in a modern pharmacy, as well as natural drugs such as mushrooms, cocaine, and marijuana. A successful Herblore check doubles the effect of Medic healing.

name: Inner Focus
description: Base chance to raise 1 attribute of your choice by 2 (max 20) and lowering 2 other attributes by 2 for the same duration. This can be triggered with one action, with a duration of twelve seconds, or after one minute of meditation with a duration of ten minutes.

name: Inspire
description: Base chance to inspire your audience with music or song. Grants +1d4 on one roll taken within 10 minutes

name: Intimidation
description: Base chance to intimidate someone with your power or importance.

name: Juggling
description: Base chance to Juggle. Large penalties for desperate moves such as catching a dagger thrown at you.

name: Latticework
description: A secret skill known only to the Magi guild, somehow crucial to the creation of magical items.

name: Lawyer
description: Your knowledge of the Law. Penalties apply to foreign cultures.

name: Leadership
description: Base chance to affect the actions of an audience. You can inspire troops, shame a mob or incite a riot.

name: Leatherworking
description: Base chance to make or field repair leather armor, shields, backpacks harness etc.

name: Linguist
description: Base chance to speak any language encountered.

name: Logistics
description: Formal military training in command and supply.

name: Magic Lore
description: Base chance to be familiar with a given magical spell, item, creature etc.

name: Mapmaking
description: Base chance to make accurate maps. Successful skill checks will sometimes cause the DM to correct your player drawn maps.

name: Masonry
description: Building with stone and or bricks, including making bricks.

name: Mathematics
description: Find a use if you can!

name: Medic
description: Know how and when unguided magical healing can be safely used on critical injuries, and improve natural healing times. A check can be made on first examining a new wound, and again after each 8 hours or more of rest by the patient. A skill check of 100+ heals 1 hit point in the most severe body section. 150+ heals heals 1 hit point in each of  the three most severe body sections. 180+ Heals heals 2 hit points in the most severe body section, and 1 hit point is all others.

name: Monster Lore
description: Base chance for a species to be known, rolled when first encountered. Know attacks/defences/weaknesses and approximate power level of the species.

name: Musical Instrument
description: Skill with a specific musical instrument.

name: Navigation
description: Base chance to find one’s way at sea.

name: Open Locks
description: Base chance to pick a lock.

name: Orienteering
description: Base chance to find one’s way on land.

name: Pick Pockets
description: Base chance to pick someone’s pocket.

name: Poisons
description: Base chance to produce effective poisons.

name: Pottery
description: You are expert at going potty. Just checking if you're paying attention.

name: Read Faces
description: Base chance to tell if someone is holding something back, or trying to convince you of something they don't believe. A successful gambling check by the target will defeat this skill. Modified by GM.

name: Read Lips
description: Base chance to know what someone is saying whom you cannot hear. You must have a clear view of their mouth and must speak the language.

name: Realm Lore
description: Base chance to know about a given place. Know the main language, famous landmarks, history, government, ruler, famous foods or goods etc.

name: Redsmith
description: Base chance to make an item from copper, tin or pewter.

name: Riding
description: Skill at riding horses.

name: Rope Use
description: Base roll to tie someone up or hoist heavy things, escape bonds, etc. Heavily modified by GM.

name: Sailing
description: Ability with boats of all sizes.

name: Sculpting
description: Your skill as a sculptor.

name: Sewing
description: A very useful skill.

name: Shipwright
description: Skill at building  boats of all sizes

name: Silversmith
description: Base chance to make or enhance an item with silver, gold or platinum.

name: Singing
description: Bring the hills to life with the sound of music.

name: Skiing
description: Cross country style.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Base chance to fool someone with a move you have practised a great deal.

name: Spelunking
description: Know the do’s and don’t of cave exploring. Includes a chance to know about slimes, fungus and other cave dwelling monsters.

name: Stealth
description: Base chance to avoid detection.

name: Swimming
description: When it matters it really matters.

name: Tactical Appraisal
description: Base chance to know the approximate Expertise, Evasion and Damage of a humanoid.

name: Thatcher
description: Skill at thatching and mending thatched roofs.

name: Tightrope Walking
description: Base chance to walk a 1” tightrope without falling.

name: Tracking
description: Base chance to track and follow through wilderness. Greatly improves ability to cover your own tracks, (and to a lesser extent your party’s).

name: Tumbling
description: Must be unfettered. Dive, roll, back flip etc.

name: Ventriloquism
description: Base chance to get away with whatever dirty trick you are trying to pull, uh, involving ventriloquism anyway.

name: Weaving
description: Skill at weaving by hand.

name: Wood Carving
description: From whittling a small toy to a ship's prow.

name: Wood Lore
description: Skill in a wilderness setting: travel smoothly, forage, find good campsites etc.

name: Wrestling
description: Skill at unarmed grappling.

name: Distillation
description: Making alchohol in myriad ways.
